lines.text: If you're choosing a tool for running several coding agents, here is what dugong does differently.
zh: 如果你在挑一个同时跑多个编码 agent 的工具，下面是 dugong 不一样的地方。

lines.text: Most tools for running agents side by side are a desktop app or a terminal, on the machine in front of you.
zh: 大多数并行跑 agent 的工具，是装在你面前这台机器上的桌面应用或终端。

lines.text: dugong is a small server. Run it on your laptop or on a box that stays on, and open the same task list from any browser, on Linux, Mac or Windows.
zh: 装在笔记本上，或者一台一直开着的机器上，用任何浏览器打开的都是同一张任务清单，Linux、Mac、Windows 都行。

lines.text: The remote controls built into agent CLIs follow one session of one agent.
zh: agent CLI 自带的远程控制，只跟着一个 agent 的一个会话。

lines.text: On dugong, your phone has every session, from ten different agents, and it gets a notification when one of them needs you.
zh: 在 dugong 里，手机上有所有会话，来自十种 agent；哪个需要你，手机就收到通知。

lines.text: Watching processes doesn't tell you much. A Claude Code session stays alive between turns, so it always looks busy.
zh: Claude Code 的会话在两轮之间一直活着，所以看起来永远在忙。

lines.text: dugong follows the turns and the background work, so a task turns red only when it needs you.
zh: dugong 看的是每一轮有没有结束、后台的活干完没有，所以只有真正需要你的任务才会变红。

lines.text: And when an agent isn't sure, it stops and waits for you. Sometimes for hours.
zh: agent 拿不准的时候，就停下来等你。
有时一等就是几个小时。

lines.text: dugong's assistant makes the small calls, writes down why, and keeps the questions for when you're back.
zh: dugong 的助手会先替你做小决定，写下为什么，把问题留到你回来再看。

lines.text: Here are the four differences side by side.
If you run one agent at a time, the CLI on its own is enough. If you run several, and want to step away, try dugong.
zh: 一次只跑一个 agent 的话，CLI 本身就够了。
同时跑好几个、还想离开电脑，就试试 dugong。
